about: A dashboard maker for e-ink screens: build it in a browser and push it to the panel.

prs.title: Calendar events without a time zone show at the right hour
prs.broken: Calendar events saved without a time zone were read as UTC, so a 9:00 meeting showed at 4:00 in New York, sometimes on the wrong day.
prs.changed: Those times are now read in the dashboard's own time zone, as the calendar standard says. Events with a zone are unchanged.
prs.matters: Meetings from common calendar exports show at the time people expect.
